Title: General availability: Azure Log Analytics in France Central, Korea Central, North Europe

Body.Content:
Azure Log Analytics is generally available in three more regions: France Central, Korea Central, and North Europe.

You can see the full list of available regions on the product webpage.

Azure Log Analytics is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Learn more about Azure Monitor and Log Analytics in the documentation.
